notes.title: Happy 1. anniversary
notes.notes:
Today marks exactly one year since our game came out on Steam. 🥳
Since then, it's stayed more or less in its original form - only a few quick fixes, but no major updates. Still, we're happy that we were able to release it and that those of you who gave it a chance found it.

We'd like to thank everyone who has supported us over the year - by adding us to their wishlist, buying the game, giving us feedback, or just a short email greeting. Your feedback makes us happy and motivated.

What's next?
Something is slowly brewing... 😉 So we'll keep this a little secret... But it's definitely not completely quiet in our studio.
